name: Export EasyEDA-compatible copy
description: Exports the board in KiCad 8 syntax so EasyEDA Pro imports it with the routing intact (needed for JLCPCB full-color silkscreen).
description_full: KiCad 10 removed the numbered net table from .kicad_pcb files: tracks, vias, zones and pads now reference nets by name instead of by number. The EasyEDA Pro importer expects the numbered form and silently drops all routing when importing KiCad 9/10 boards. This plugin adds a one-click export that rewrites the saved board into KiCad 8 syntax (rebuilt net table, v8 layer numbering, v10-only tokens stripped) and produces a zip ready to import in EasyEDA Pro — footprints AND routing. Typical use case: ordering JLCPCB full-color silkscreen, which only accepts fabrication files exported from EasyEDA Pro.
